q: 他昨天___我商量了很久，最后决定换工作。
zh: 他昨天跟我商量了很久，最后决定换工作。
py: tā zuó tiān gēn wǒ shāng liáng le hěn jiǔ zuì hòu jué dìng huàn gōng zuò
en: He discussed it with me for a long time yesterday and finally decided to change jobs.
why: 商量 is a two-sided act with a partner, so 跟 comes before it. 给 and 对 cannot mark a discussion partner.

q: 我们几个同事中午常常___公司附近的饭馆吃饭。
zh: 我们几个同事中午常常在公司附近的饭馆吃饭。
py: wǒ men jǐ gè tóng shì zhōng wǔ cháng cháng zài gōng sī fù jìn de fàn guǎn chī fàn
en: We colleagues often eat at a restaurant near the company at noon.
why: The location of an ongoing habit takes 在 before 吃饭. 往 would need a movement verb, and 对 and 给 need a person.

zh: 请把这些文件放在经理的桌子上。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè xiē wén jiàn fàng zài jīng lǐ de zhuō zi shàng
en: Please put these documents on the manager's desk.
why: 放在 stays together right after the 把 object, and the place it ends up goes after it.

q: 我每天___地铁上班。
zh: 我每天坐地铁上班。
py: wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě shàng bān
en: I take the subway to work every day.
why: Riding in a public vehicle is 坐 + vehicle, before the movement. 骑 is for bicycles and 开 is for driving it yourself.

q: 你可以___手机付钱，不用带现金。
zh: 你可以用手机付钱，不用带现金。
py: nǐ kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī fù qián bù yòng dài xiàn jīn
en: You can pay with your phone; you do not need to carry cash.
why: The phone is the tool used for paying, so 用 + 手机. 坐 and 骑 are for transport, and 给手机 would mean giving the phone away.

q: 我今天迟到了，所以___老师道歉了。
zh: 我今天迟到了，所以向老师道歉了。
py: wǒ jīn tiān chí dào le suǒ yǐ xiàng lǎo shī dào qiàn le
en: I was late today, so I apologised to the teacher.
why: 道歉 is an abstract act directed at a person, and only 向 fits that. 往 needs a direction, and 从 and 离 are about starting points and distance.

zh: 小李明天跟老师见面。
py: xiǎo lǐ míng tiān gēn lǎo shī jiàn miàn
en: Xiao Li is meeting the teacher tomorrow.
why: The partner phrase 跟老师 comes before 见面, which cannot take an object. 见面老师 is a classic error.

q: 她___我笑了笑，什么也没说。
zh: 她朝我笑了笑，什么也没说。
py: tā cháo wǒ xiào le xiào shén me yě méi shuō
en: She smiled at me and did not say anything.
why: 朝 + person faces the person with the gesture. 往 does not take a person, 跟 would need a partner, and 离 is a distance word.

s_py: wǒ men chī wǔ fàn zài shí táng
zh: 我们在食堂吃午饭。
py: wǒ men zài shí táng chī wǔ fàn
en: We eat lunch in the canteen.
why: The place of the activity must come before the verb. 在食堂 cannot follow 吃午饭.

zh: 我坐公共汽车去学校。
py: wǒ zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù xué xiào
en: I take the bus to school.
why: The vehicle phrase 坐公共汽车 goes before the movement verb 去.

q: 小王每天早上___教室读英语。
zh: 小王每天早上在教室读英语。
py: xiǎo wáng měi tiān zǎo shàng zài jiào shì dú yīng yǔ
en: Xiao Wang reads English in the classroom every morning.
why: Where an activity takes place is set before the verb with 在. 给 and 对 need a person, and 往 needs a direction plus movement, so none of them can introduce the place of 读英语.

zh: 我每天坐地铁上班。
py: wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě shàng bān
en: I go to work by subway every day.
why: The vehicle phrase 坐地铁 comes before the action 上班, and the time word stands before the vehicle.

s: 到了前面的路口，你往右拐。
zh: 到了前面的路口，你往右拐。
py: dào le qián miàn de lù kǒu nǐ wǎng yòu guǎi
en: When you get to the junction ahead, turn right.
why: 往 + direction + movement verb 拐 is exactly the right pattern, so the sentence is correct.

zh: 我打算坐火车去北京参加面试。
py: wǒ dǎ suàn zuò huǒ chē qù běi jīng cān jiā miàn shì
en: I plan to take the train to Beijing for an interview.
why: The modal 打算 goes first, then the vehicle phrase 坐火车 before the movement verb 去.

q: 老师___我们介绍了一位新同学。
zh: 老师给我们介绍了一位新同学。
py: lǎo shī gěi wǒ men jiè shào le yī wèi xīn tóng xue
en: The teacher introduced a new classmate to us.
why: 介绍 something to someone takes 给 for the recipient. 跟我们 would make us co-introducers, and 往 cannot take a person.

q: 她把照片发___我了。
zh: 她把照片发给我了。
py: tā bǎ zhào piān fā gěi wǒ le
en: She has sent me the photos.
why: The person who receives the photos follows 发 directly as 发给. 在 would need a place, and 往 does not take a person.

q: 小王想___女朋友结婚，可是他还没有钱。
zh: 小王想跟女朋友结婚，可是他还没有钱。
py: xiǎo wáng xiǎng gēn nǚ péng you jié hūn kě shì tā hái méi yǒu qián
en: Xiao Wang wants to marry his girlfriend, but he has no money yet.
why: 结婚 cannot take an object; the other person is marked with 跟 / 和. 给 and 对 do not fit a mutual event.

src_py: tā zuó tiān gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà le
zh: 他昨天没给我打电话。
py: tā zuó tiān méi gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
en: He did not call me yesterday.
why: Negating a past action uses 没 before 给我 and drops 了. 给我没打电话 is wrong.

src_py: wǒ zài jiā chī wǔ fàn
zh: 我不在家吃午饭。
py: wǒ bù zài jiā chī wǔ fàn
en: I do not eat lunch at home.
why: 不 goes before the coverb phrase 在家, not between 在家 and 吃. 在家不吃 is wrong.

zh: 学生们常常用电脑写作业。
py: xué sheng men cháng cháng yòng diàn nǎo xiě zuò yè
en: The students often do their homework on the computer.
why: The tool phrase 用电脑 sits between the adverb 常常 and the verb 写作业.

q: 他的意见跟我的___一样，所以我们吵了起来。
zh: 他的意见跟我的不一样，所以我们吵了起来。
py: tā de yì jiàn gēn wǒ de bù yí yàng suǒ yǐ wǒ men chǎo le qǐ lái
en: His opinion is different from mine, so we ended up arguing.
why: 一样 is a state predicate, so 不 goes on it after 跟我的. 没一样 is not used, and 都 would say they match, which contradicts the argument.

s: 她不在这家公司工作了。
zh: 她不在这家公司工作了。
py: tā bù zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le
en: She no longer works at this company.
why: 不 goes before the coverb 在这家公司, and 了 marks the change. This is correct.

q: 我已经___经理发了一封邮件。
zh: 我已经给经理发了一封邮件。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng gěi jīng lǐ fà le yī fēng yóu jiàn
en: I have already sent the manager an email.
why: The manager receives the email, so the recipient is marked with 给. 跟 would make the manager a partner in the act, and 往 cannot take a person.

zh: 你一直往前走。
py: nǐ yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu
en: Just keep going straight ahead.
why: 一直 comes before the coverb phrase 往前, which comes before the movement verb 走.

zh: 同事们下午在会议室讨论新计划。
py: tóng shì men xià wǔ zài huì yì shì tǎo lùn xīn jì huà
en: The colleagues are discussing the new plan in the meeting room this afternoon.
why: Subject, time, then the 在 phrase, then the verb and object. 在会议室 cannot follow 讨论 here.

src_py: wǒ míng tiān jiàn lǐ lǎo shī
task: Rewrite with 跟 and 见面.
zh: 我明天跟李老师见面。
py: wǒ míng tiān gēn lǐ lǎo shī jiàn miàn
en: I am meeting Teacher Li tomorrow.
why: 见面 takes no object, so the person becomes 跟李老师 before the verb.

q: 老板对员工一点儿都___好，所以大家都想离开这家公司。
zh: 老板对员工一点儿都不好，所以大家都想离开这家公司。
py: lǎo bǎn duì yuán gōng yì diǎn ér dōu bù hǎo suǒ yǐ dà jiā dōu xiǎng lí kāi zhè jiā gōng sī
en: The boss is not nice to the staff at all, so everyone wants to leave the company.
why: 一点儿都 needs a negative, and for the adjective 好 that is 不, placed on it after 对员工. 太 and 很 are positive and 别 is a command.

zh: 我住在学校附近。
py: wǒ zhù zài xué xiào fù jìn
en: I live near the school.
why: 住 is one of the verbs that allows 在 + place right after it, so this is correct. Do not mark it wrong just because the place follows the verb.

q: 我们应该___那位老师学习，他工作非常认真。
zh: 我们应该向那位老师学习，他工作非常认真。
py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng nà wèi lǎo shī xué xí tā gōng zuò fēi cháng rèn zhēn
en: We should learn from that teacher; he works very conscientiously.
why: Learning from a person uses 向 + person + 学习. 往 only goes with directions and movement, and 离 is a distance word.

q: 咖啡店离办公室___远，走两分钟就到。
zh: 咖啡店离办公室不远，走两分钟就到。
py: kā fēi diàn lí bàn gōng shì bù yuǎn zǒu liǎng fēn zhōng jiù dào
en: The cafe is not far from the office; it is a two-minute walk.
why: 远 is an adjective predicate, so the negative 不 sits right on it, after 离办公室. 没 negates 有 or past events, and the walking time shows it is not 很 far.

q: 小王对我很好，小李___对我很好。
zh: 小王对我很好，小李也对我很好。
py: xiǎo wáng duì wǒ hěn hǎo xiǎo lǐ yě duì wǒ hěn hǎo
en: Xiao Wang is very nice to me, and Xiao Li is also very nice to me.
why: Adverbs like 也 go before the coverb: 也对我很好. 都 needs a plural subject, and 又 and 才 do not mean "too" here.

q: 这本书___学习汉语很有帮助。
zh: 这本书对学习汉语很有帮助。
py: zhè běn shū duì xué xí hàn yǔ hěn yǒu bāng zhù
en: This book is very helpful for learning Chinese.
why: The effect on a purpose or person is 对 + noun + 有帮助. 跟 would mean "together with learning Chinese".

q: 这儿___火车站有五公里，打车比较方便。
zh: 这儿离火车站有五公里，打车比较方便。
py: zhè ér lí huǒ chē zhàn yǒu wǔ gōng lǐ dǎ chē bǐ jiào fāng biàn
en: It is five kilometres from here to the train station, so a taxi is more convenient.
why: The gap between two fixed points followed by 有 + distance is 离. 从 would need a movement verb and an endpoint.

zh: 他对我也很好。
py: tā duì wǒ yě hěn hǎo
en: He is also very nice to me.
why: 也 goes before the coverb 对我, and 很 stays on 好. This is the normal position for both.

q: 我想___同学一起准备考试。
zh: 我想跟同学一起准备考试。
py: wǒ xiǎng gēn tóng xue yì qǐ zhǔn bèi kǎo shì
en: I want to prepare for the exam together with my classmates.
why: 一起 asks for a partner in a shared activity, which is 跟 (or 和). 给 would make the classmates recipients, and 对 only marks an attitude or effect.

q: 同学们把桌子搬___另一个教室了。
zh: 同学们把桌子搬到另一个教室了。
py: tóng xue men bǎ zhuō zi bān dào lìng yí gè jiào shì le
en: The students moved the desks to another classroom.
why: 搬 + 到 + place says where the desks end up after being carried. 搬在 is not used, and 给 would need a person.

q: 妈妈每个星期都___我寄一些水果。
zh: 妈妈每个星期都给我寄一些水果。
py: mā mā měi gè xīng qī dōu gěi wǒ jì yī xiē shuǐ guǒ
en: My mother sends me some fruit every week.
why: The recipient of the parcel is introduced with 给 before 寄. 跟 would need a partner, and 往 does not take a person.

s_py: wǒ gēn zhōng wén hěn gǎn xìng qù
zh: 我对中文很感兴趣。
py: wǒ duì zhōng wén hěn gǎn xìng qù
en: I am very interested in Chinese.
why: 感兴趣 needs 对 for its object. 跟 marks a partner in a shared act.

q: 我们都___他的健康担心。
zh: 我们都为他的健康担心。
py: wǒ men dōu wèi tā de jiàn kāng dān xīn
en: We are all worried about his health.
why: The thing or person you worry about is introduced with 为 before 担心. 对他的健康担心 and 往 do not work.

zh: 我昨天没给他打电话。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi gěi tā dǎ diàn huà
en: I did not call him yesterday.
why: 没 goes before the coverb 给他, not between 给他 and 打电话. 给他没打电话 is a classic error.

q: 我想___你聊聊天。
zh: 我想跟你聊聊天。
py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ liáo liáo tiān
en: I would like to chat with you.
why: 聊天 is a mutual act, so the other person is marked with 跟 / 和. 给你聊天 and 对你聊天 do not work.

s: 我们学校从火车站很远。
s_py: wǒ men xué xiào cóng huǒ chē zhàn hěn yuǎn
zh: 我们学校离火车站很远。
py: wǒ men xué xiào lí huǒ chē zhàn hěn yuǎn
en: Our school is far from the train station.
why: Distance between two places is 离. 从 only marks a starting point.

s: 我们公司离地铁站不远。
zh: 我们公司离地铁站不远。
py: wǒ men gōng sī lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn
en: Our company is not far from the subway station.
why: 远 is the adjective predicate, so 不 sits on it after 离地铁站. This is correct.

s: 你考了第一名，我真对你高兴。
s_py: nǐ kǎo le dì yì míng wǒ zhēn duì nǐ gāo xìng
zh: 你考了第一名，我真为你高兴。
py: nǐ kǎo le dì yì míng wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
en: You came first; I am really happy for you.
why: Being happy on someone's account takes 为. 对你高兴 does not exist.

q: 请把你的名字写___这张纸上。
zh: 请把你的名字写在这张纸上。
py: qǐng bǎ nǐ de míng zì xiě zài zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng
en: Please write your name on this sheet of paper.
why: The paper is where the name ends up, so 在 attaches directly to 写. 给 would mean writing it for someone, and 从 marks a starting point.

q: 我明天有点儿事，你能___我去开会吗？
zh: 我明天有点儿事，你能替我去开会吗？
py: wǒ míng tiān yǒu diǎn ér shì nǐ néng tì wǒ qù kāi huì ma
en: I have something on tomorrow; can you go to the meeting in my place?
why: Going in someone's place, so that they do not have to, is 替. 给我去开会 is not a way to say someone goes in your place.

q: 李老师昨天___上海出差回来，今天下午就给我们上课。
zh: 李老师昨天从上海出差回来，今天下午就给我们上课。
py: lǐ lǎo shī zuó tiān cóng shàng hǎi chū chāi huí lái jīn tiān xià wǔ jiù gěi wǒ men shàng kè
en: Teacher Li came back from a business trip in Shanghai yesterday and is teaching us this afternoon.
why: The place the return trip starts from is 从. 离 would state a distance, and 往 points toward a destination, not the origin.

s_py: wǒ fàng shū zài zhuō zi shàng le
zh: 我把书放在桌子上了。
py: wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
en: I have put the book on the table.
why: 在 attaches directly to 放, and the object moves forward with 把. 放书在 splits them.

q: 老板把这个文件交___我了。
zh: 老板把这个文件交给我了。
py: lǎo bǎn bǎ zhè ge wén jiàn jiāo gěi wǒ le
en: The boss handed this document over to me.
why: 交 something to a person takes 给 right after the verb, with 把 for the definite object. 在 and 到 mark places, not a person who receives.

q: 你一直___前走，银行就在左边。
zh: 你一直往前走，银行就在左边。
py: nǐ yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu yín háng jiù zài zuǒ biān
en: Just keep walking straight ahead; the bank is on the left.
why: 往前走 gives the direction of a movement. 在前走 would put the verb in the wrong frame, and 对 and 给 need a person.

s_py: tā gěi wǒ méi fā yóu jiàn
zh: 他没给我发邮件。
py: tā méi gěi wǒ fā yóu jiàn
en: He did not send me an email.
why: 没 belongs before the coverb 给我, not between 给我 and 发.

q: 考试的时候，老师不让我们___手机查词典。
zh: 考试的时候，老师不让我们用手机查词典。
py: kǎo shì de shí hou lǎo shī bù ràng wǒ men yòng shǒu jī chá cí diǎn
en: During the exam the teacher does not let us use our phones to look things up in a dictionary.
why: The phone is the tool for looking up words, so 用手机 comes before 查. 坐 and 骑 are for vehicles.

q: 老师___我们很好。
zh: 老师对我们很好。
py: lǎo shī duì wǒ men hěn hǎo
en: The teacher is very good to us.
why: 对 marks the target of an attitude or treatment: 对我们很好. 给 needs a thing or action that is handed over.

src_py: wǒ bǎ wén jiàn jiāo gěi jīng lǐ
task: Say you have not done it yet.
zh: 我还没把文件交给经理。
py: wǒ hái méi bǎ wén jiàn jiāo gěi jīng lǐ
en: I have not handed the document to the manager yet.
why: 还没 goes before 把, and 交给 stays together after the 把 object.

q: 我弟弟___数学很感兴趣。
zh: 我弟弟对数学很感兴趣。
py: wǒ dì di duì shù xué hěn gǎn xìng qù
en: My younger brother is very interested in maths.
why: 感兴趣 is an attitude toward something, so it needs 对. 跟 is for a partner and 给 for a recipient.

src_py: tú shū guǎn lí jiào shì hěn jìn
zh: 图书馆离教室不近。
py: tú shū guǎn lí jiào shì bù jìn
en: The library is not close to the classroom.
why: Replace 很 with 不 on the adjective 近, after the coverb phrase 离教室.

q: 从公司___我家要坐四十分钟地铁。
zh: 从公司到我家要坐四十分钟地铁。
py: cóng gōng sī dào wǒ jiā yào zuò sì shí fēn zhōng dì tiě
en: It takes forty minutes by subway from the company to my home.
why: The pair is 从 … 到 for start and end of a route. 离 does not pair with 从, and 往 and 对 do not mark an endpoint.

q: 我们开车把客人送___机场，然后才回公司。
zh: 我们开车把客人送到机场，然后才回公司。
py: wǒ men kāi chē bǎ kè rén sòng dào jī chǎng rán hòu cái huí gōng sī
en: We drove the guests to the airport and only then went back to the company.
why: The airport is where the guests end up after being taken, so 送到. 送给 would mean giving something to a person, and 送在 is not used.

s_py: wǒ měi tiān yòng dì tiě shàng bān
zh: 我每天坐地铁上班。
py: wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě shàng bān
en: I take the subway to work every day.
why: A vehicle you ride in takes 坐. 用 is only for tools.

q: 我已经___导师商量过毕业论文的题目了。
zh: 我已经跟导师商量过毕业论文的题目了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng gēn dǎo shī shāng liáng guò bì yè lùn wén de tí mù le
en: I have already discussed the topic of my graduation thesis with my supervisor.
why: 商量 is a two-way act, so the partner is introduced by 跟 / 和. 给 would make the supervisor a mere recipient, and 对 marks an attitude, not a partner.

zh: 我每天在图书馆学习。
py: wǒ měi tiān zài tú shū guǎn xué xí
en: I study in the library every day.
why: The place phrase 在图书馆 stands before 学习, and the time word comes before it. Putting 在图书馆 after the verb is English order and wrong.

q: 经理出差了，这个星期的会议由我___他主持。
zh: 经理出差了，这个星期的会议由我替他主持。
py: jīng lǐ chū chāi le zhè ge xīng qī de huì yì yóu wǒ tì tā zhǔ chí
en: The manager is away on a trip, so I will chair this week's meeting in his place.
why: 主持 done in his place is 替他. 对 and 往 do not express acting on behalf of someone.

s: 我们开车把同事送在火车站了。
s_py: wǒ men kāi chē bǎ tóng shì sòng zài huǒ chē zhàn le
zh: 我们开车把同事送到火车站了。
py: wǒ men kāi chē bǎ tóng shì sòng dào huǒ chē zhàn le
en: We drove our colleague to the train station.
why: Taking someone to a place is 送到. 送在 is not used.

q: 听说你考上了大学，我真___你高兴。
zh: 听说你考上了大学，我真为你高兴。
py: tīng shuō nǐ kǎo shàng le dà xué wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
en: I heard you got into university; I am really happy for you.
why: Feeling happy on someone's account takes 为. 对你高兴 does not exist, and 给 and 往 do not fit a feeling.

zh: 我把名字写在书上了。
py: wǒ bǎ míng zì xiě zài shū shàng le
en: I wrote my name in the book.
why: The book is where the name ends up, so 在 attaches to 写 after 把. This is the correct pattern.

src_py: wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
zh: 我把书放在桌子上了。
py: wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
en: I have put the book on the table.
why: 了 goes after the whole unit 放在桌子上, and 放在 cannot be split.

s_py: wǒ men yào wǎng lǎo shī xué xí
zh: 我们要向老师学习。
py: wǒ men yào xiàng lǎo shī xué xí
en: We should learn from the teacher.
why: 往 needs a direction or place and a movement verb. Learning from a person is 向.

s: 他昨天跟我说了这件事。
zh: 他昨天跟我说了这件事。
py: tā zuó tiān gēn wǒ shuō le zhè jiàn shì
en: He told me about this yesterday.
why: With 说 the person can be marked with 跟 as well as 对, so this is correct.

q: 经理明天要___客户见面。
zh: 经理明天要跟客户见面。
py: jīng lǐ míng tiān yào gēn kè hù jiàn miàn
en: The manager is going to meet a client tomorrow.
why: 见面 is mutual and cannot take an object, so the other person comes in with 跟 before the verb. 给客户 or 对客户 cannot sit in front of 见面.

zh: 请替我向他问好。
py: qǐng tì wǒ xiàng tā wèn hǎo
en: Please say hello to him for me.
why: 替我 means in my place and comes before 向他, which in turn comes before the verb 问好.

q: 你家___公司远不远？
zh: 你家离公司远不远？
py: nǐ jiā lí gōng sī yuǎn bù yuǎn
en: Is your home far from the company?
why: A question about distance between two places uses 离 with 远 / 近. 从 and 在 need a movement or a location of an action.

zh: 离考试还有三天。
py: lí kǎo shì hái yǒu sān tiān
en: There are still three days until the exam.
why: 离 + event + 还有 + time is the standard way to count the time left, so no 从 is needed here.

q: 到了十字路口，你___右拐。
zh: 到了十字路口，你往右拐。
py: dào le shí zì lù kǒu nǐ wǎng yòu guǎi
en: When you reach the crossroads, turn right.
why: 往 + direction + movement verb is the pattern for turning or going. 对, 给 and 跟 do not take a direction.

q: 我感冒了，小王___我请了一天假。
zh: 我感冒了，小王替我请了一天假。
py: wǒ gǎn mào le xiǎo wáng tì wǒ qǐng le yī tiān jiǎ
en: I have a cold, so Xiao Wang asked for a day off for me, in my place.
why: Doing the errand in place of the sick person is 替. 对 and 往 do not mark a stand-in, and 离 is a distance word.

q: 我们___八点开始上课。
zh: 我们从八点开始上课。
py: wǒ men cóng bā diǎn kāi shǐ shàng kè
en: We start class at eight.
why: 从 marks the point where a period starts. 离 gives the gap between two points and cannot be followed by 开始 like this.

q: 我们每周___周一___周五都有课。
zh: 我们每周从周一到周五都有课。
py: wǒ men měi zhōu cóng zhōu yī dào zhōu wǔ dōu yǒu kè
en: We have classes every week from Monday to Friday.
why: 从 starts the span and 到 ends it, in that order. 离 cannot form a span of time, and swapping the two words reverses the span.

q: 今天晚上我___跟同学一起复习，你也来吧。
zh: 今天晚上我要跟同学一起复习，你也来吧。
py: jīn tiān wǎn shàng wǒ yào gēn tóng xue yì qǐ fù xí nǐ yě lái ba
en: I am going to review with my classmates tonight; come along too.
why: A modal like 要 goes before 跟同学. 不 and 没 would cancel the plan, which clashes with 你也来吧, and 别 is a command, not a statement about me.

q: 你放心吧，别___我担心。
zh: 你放心吧，别为我担心。
py: nǐ fàng xīn ba bié wèi wǒ dān xīn
en: Do not worry about me; stop worrying.
why: 担心 on someone's account is 为我担心. 对 and 往 do not mark the cause of a worry.

src_py: wǒ tì nǐ qù kāi huì
task: Turn it into a question with 能.
zh: 我能替你去开会吗？
py: wǒ néng tì nǐ qù kāi huì ma
en: Can I go to the meeting in your place?
why: The modal 能 goes before the coverb 替你, and 吗 closes the question.

zh: 我想跟你商量一件事。
py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ shāng liáng yī jiàn shì
en: I would like to discuss something with you.
why: The modal 想 goes before the coverb phrase 跟你, and 商量 follows the partner phrase directly.

zh: 新办公室离地铁站不远。
py: xīn bàn gōng shì lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn
en: The new office is not far from the subway station.
why: 远 is an adjective predicate, so 不 goes right before it, after 离地铁站.

zh: 他对音乐很感兴趣。
py: tā duì yīn yuè hěn gǎn xìng qù
en: He is very interested in music.
why: 对音乐 comes right after the subject, and 很 goes before the predicate 感兴趣.

q: ___考试还有两个星期，我们得好好复习。
zh: 离考试还有两个星期，我们得好好复习。
py: lí kǎo shì hái yǒu liǎng gè xīng qī wǒ men děi hǎo hǎo fù xí
en: There are two weeks left until the exam, so we have to review properly.
why: 离 + event + 还有 + time counts the gap before the event. 从 would mark a start, not the time that remains.

q: 他刚___图书馆回来。
zh: 他刚从图书馆回来。
py: tā gāng cóng tú shū guǎn huí lái
en: He has just come back from the library.
why: The library is the place the movement starts from, so 从. 离 is for distance and 在图书馆回来 would be ungrammatical.

zh: 从公司到我家要四十分钟。
py: cóng gōng sī dào wǒ jiā yào sì shí fēn zhōng
en: It takes forty minutes from the company to my home.
why: 从 + start and 到 + end come first, as the topic of the route, and the time taken follows with 要.

zh: 请替我向经理问好。
py: qǐng tì wǒ xiàng jīng lǐ wèn hǎo
en: Please say hello to the manager for me.
why: 替我 gives the stand-in and 向经理 gives the person addressed, both before 问好. This is the correct order.

src_py: xué xiào lí wǒ jiā hěn yuǎn
task: Turn it into an A-not-A question.
zh: 学校离我家远不远？
py: xué xiào lí wǒ jiā yuǎn bù yuǎn
en: Is the school far from my home?
why: The A-not-A question repeats the predicate 远不远 after the coverb phrase 离我家.

q: 中国人常常___筷子吃饭。
zh: 中国人常常用筷子吃饭。
py: zhōng guó rén cháng cháng yòng kuài zi chī fàn
en: Chinese people often eat with chopsticks.
why: A tool is introduced with 用 before the verb: 用筷子吃饭. 坐 is for vehicles you ride in and 骑 is for bikes and horses.

q: 新来的同事___大家都很客气，也很愿意帮助别人。
zh: 新来的同事对大家都很客气，也很愿意帮助别人。
py: xīn lái de tóng shì duì dà jiā dōu hěn kè qi yě hěn yuàn yì bāng zhù bié rén
en: The new colleague is polite to everyone and willing to help others.
why: Politeness is an attitude toward people, so 对大家 comes before the adjective. 给 would need a handed-over thing.

s_py: wǒ míng tiān jiàn miàn lǎo shī
zh: 我明天跟老师见面。
py: wǒ míng tiān gēn lǎo shī jiàn miàn
en: I am meeting the teacher tomorrow.
why: 见面 cannot take an object; the other person needs 跟 / 和 before the verb.

q: ___暑假开始只剩一个星期了，同学们都在计划去哪儿玩。
zh: 离暑假开始只剩一个星期了，同学们都在计划去哪儿玩。
py: lí shǔ jià kāi shǐ zhǐ shèng yí gè xīng qī le tóng xue men dōu zài jì huà qù nǎ ér wán
en: Only one week is left before the summer holiday starts, and everyone is planning where to go.
why: The time still remaining before an event is 离 + event + 只剩 / 还有 + time. 从 would mean "starting from the holiday", which does not fit 只剩.

q: 我们明天___公共汽车去北京大学。
zh: 我们明天坐公共汽车去北京大学。
py: wǒ men míng tiān zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù běi jīng dà xué
en: We are taking the bus to Peking University tomorrow.
why: Travelling by bus is 坐 + vehicle before 去. 用公共汽车 would treat the bus as a tool, and 骑 is for bicycles.

s: 老师用电脑给我们放电影。
zh: 老师用电脑给我们放电影。
py: lǎo shī yòng diàn nǎo gěi wǒ men fàng diàn yǐng
en: The teacher plays a film for us on the computer.
why: Two coverb phrases can stack before one verb: the tool 用电脑 first, then the recipient 给我们.

q: 多睡觉___身体好。
zh: 多睡觉对身体好。
py: duō shuì jiào duì shēn tǐ hǎo
en: Sleeping more is good for your health.
why: The effect on the body is 对身体好. 跟 would mean "together with the body", and 给 means to give.

q: 你___在这儿大声说话，同学们正在考试。
zh: 你别在这儿大声说话，同学们正在考试。
py: nǐ bié zài zhè ér dà shēng shuō huà tóng xue men zhèng zài kǎo shì
en: Do not talk loudly here; the students are taking an exam.
why: An order not to do something uses 别, and it goes before the coverb phrase: 别在这儿说话. 没 is for past facts and 也 and 很 make no sense as a command.

q: 小李___办公室里打印文件。
zh: 小李在办公室里打印文件。
py: xiǎo lǐ zài bàn gōng shì lǐ dǎ yìn wén jiàn
en: Xiao Li is printing documents in the office.
why: The place where the printing happens is 在 + place before the verb. 给, 跟 and 向 all need a person, not a room.

src_py: lǎo shī duì wǒ men hěn hǎo
task: Say the teacher is also good to us.
zh: 老师也对我们很好。
py: lǎo shī yě duì wǒ men hěn hǎo
en: The teacher is also very nice to us.
why: 也 goes before the coverb 对我们, while 很 stays on the adjective.

q: 他喜欢___自行车去学校。
zh: 他喜欢骑自行车去学校。
py: tā xǐ huān qí zì xíng chē qù xué xiào
en: He likes riding his bicycle to school.
why: A bicycle is ridden, so 骑 + 自行车. 开 is for driving a car, and 坐 does not describe sitting astride a bike.

q: 我家___学校很近，走路五分钟。
zh: 我家离学校很近，走路五分钟。
py: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng
en: My home is close to school; it is a five-minute walk.
why: Nothing moves here: the sentence gives the gap between two places, which is 离 + 近. 从 needs a starting point of movement.

zh: 我把照片发给你了。
py: wǒ bǎ zhào piān fā gěi nǐ le
en: I have sent you the photos.
why: 发给 stays together as one unit after 把照片, and 了 goes after the recipient at the end.
